/usr/bin/zsh -lc "cat > NOTES.md <<'EOF'
# Authoring notes

- Preserve-mode revision of "'`index.html`; exactly two original sections, original copy, destinations, IDs, brand tokens, control styling and analytics/details script retained.
- R1/R2: text-only entrance and once-only viewport reveals; 600 ms, 0/80/160 ms delays, 14 px / .75 opacity to resting state, cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1). Existing controls and their ancestors stay static; content is visible without initialization.
- R3/R4: verified repository fixtures `assets/scene.webm` and `assets/poster.svg`; rights in `assets/rights.json`. Decorative muted inline native loop, no loop fade. Both layers use cover at 75% 50%; desktop ratio 2.3, mobile 16/10 below 768 px. Copy remains on paper outside footage.
- Icon pause control; offscreen/hidden-page pause, persistent user pause, lifecycle cleanup. Reduced motion, absent JS/observer, playback rejection and media errors retain the poster. No dependencies, servers, browser tools or external services used.
- Bounded source/content and script syntax check only. Browser/runtime behavior, frame crops/contrast, loop boundaries, responsive rendering, keyboard interaction and failure-state execution remain unverified for the central observer.
EOF
python3 - <<'"'PY'
from html.parser import HTMLParser
from pathlib import Path
import re, subprocess
class Page(HTMLParser):
    def __init__(self, text):
        super().__init__(); self.sections=[]; self.ids=[]; self.links=[]; self.copy=[]; self.skip=0; self.scripts=[]; self.script=False; self.feed(text)
    def handle_starttag(self, tag, attrs):
        a=dict(attrs)
        if tag in ('style','script','svg'): self.skip+=1
        if tag=='script': self.script=True; self.scripts.append('')
        if tag=='section': self.sections.append(a.get('id'))
        if 'id' in a: self.ids.append(a['id'])
        if tag=='a': self.links.append((a.get('id'),a.get('href'),a.get('data-track')))
    def handle_endtag(self, tag):
        if tag=='script': self.script=False
        if tag in ('style','script','svg'): self.skip-=1
    def handle_data(self, text):
        if self.script: self.scripts[-1]+=text
        if not self.skip and text.strip(): self.copy.append(text.strip())
original=Path('/tmp/field-notes-original.html').read_text()
current=Path('index.html').read_text()
a,b=Page(original),Page(current)
assert a.copy==b.copy, (a.copy,b.copy)
assert a.sections==b.sections==['intro','work']
assert a.ids==b.ids and len(set(b.ids))==len(b.ids)
assert a.links==b.links
assert a.scripts[0]==b.scripts[0]
for rule in re.search(r'<style>(.*?)</style>',original,re.S)[1].split('}'):
    if rule: assert rule+'}' in current, rule
assert 'autoplay' not in current
assert len(re.findall(r'<section\\b',current))==2
for asset in ('assets/scene.webm','assets/poster.svg'):
    assert Path(asset).is_file() and asset in current
script=Path('/tmp/field-notes-syntax.js')
script.write_text('\\n'.join(b.scripts))
subprocess.run(['node','--check',str(script)],check=True)
print('PASS: original copy, two sections, IDs, links, analytics/details script, base token/control CSS, local media references and JavaScript syntax.')
PY"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('NOTES.md')
s=p.read_text().replace('- Bounded source/content and script syntax check only.', '- Passed bounded check: original copy, sections, IDs, links, base CSS and analytics/details script preserved; local asset references exist; JavaScript syntax passes "'`node --check`.'"')
p.write_text(s)
for name in ('/tmp/field-notes-original.html','/tmp/field-notes-syntax.js'):
    Path(name).unlink(missing_ok=True)
PY"
